principle: Independence is a provenance property, not a count of agreeing reports.
independent_when: claims terminate in distinct frozen provenance roots
no declared upstream producer, sensor, model inference, dataset event, or capture channel is shared before the independence boundary
shared downstream transport or storage does not by itself destroy independence
dependent_when: claims derive from the same sensor observation
claims derive from the same model output or common upstream inference
one claim is copied, transformed, summarized, or re-signed from the other
the frozen scenario declares a shared root before the independence boundary
unknown_when: source lineage cannot establish or refute a shared upstream root
